
## Archive migration update — 29 October 2026

The earlier 'integration pending' section below describes the dependency-only stage. Integration into the application sources is now implemented but not end-to-end validated: all active ZipBuilder/TDFUnRar references have been removed and MMArchiveEngine.pas handles listing/extraction. Native Win32/Win64 ZIP, RAR4 and 7z standalone tests pass. Full app builds are still blocked by unrelated TMMSettings.cpp errors. UI/installer parity has not passed. See ARCHIVE_MIGRATION.md and PROJECT_STATUS.md in the repository root.

# d7zip — Map Manager Win32 installation

Installed and validated on DEV: 2026-10-29

Upstream: https://github.com/geoffsmith82/d7zip
Pinned commit: 38bee12a32a31bf1364cc31c0572b445bd5dc5cf (2025-12-27)
Wrapper licence: MPL 1.1, preserved in License.
Source author credits remain at top of sevenzip.pas.

## Installed layout
- sevenzip.pas: complete Delphi wrapper calling 7z.dll inside the Map Manager process.
- generated/Win32/sevenzip.hpp: header generated by C++Builder 37.0 for C++ callers.
- README.md and License: upstream documentation and licensing.
- Project1.cbproj: DelphiCompile item for ThirdParty\d7zip\sevenzip.pas, Win32 C++ header search path.
- Win32\Debug\7z.dll: 32-bit native library, downloaded as 7-Zip 26.05 from official 7-Zip GitHub release and placed beside test/dev executable; excluded from Git. A separate official distribution licence is at ThirdParty\7Zip\License.txt.
- Original source cloned at C:\Temp\MapManagerDeps\d7zip.

This is a nonvisual Delphi unit and does NOT require installation in RAD Studio's visual component palette. The repo's optional example GUI requires JVCL but its sevenzip.pas source does not.

## Verified tests

1. Delphi 37.0 Win32 builds sevenzip.pas, success (exit 0).
2. ZIP and 7z fixtures: native Delphi program opens and enumerates, extracts members to memory, validates decompressed lengths; success.
3. Original historical RAR fixture, Map Manager\MM\TDFUnRar.rar: 34 entries enumerated, all 30 files extracted into memory and sizes verified (604898 uncompressed bytes); success.
4. ZIP and 7z archives created with d7zip API, subsequently opened and extracted through d7zip; success for both.
5. The project file parses as valid XML and lists the DelphiCompile entry.
6. Test sources and build logs stored at C:\Temp\MapManagerDeps; no external archiver executable was invoked by the native Delphi read/write programs.

RAR5 fixture has not yet been tested, though the library exposes CLSID_CFormatRar5. The bundled factory currently maps *.rar to classic RAR handler; an app adapter must distinguish RAR4 from RAR5.

## Integration status

This component has been downloaded, source-vendored, compiled, read/write verified, and registered as a Delphi source unit in the recovered C++Builder project. It is NOT a complete replacement of Map Manager archive-handling code yet.

The legacy C++ application still calls ZipBuilder and DFUnRar in:
- TMMArchives.cpp / TMMArchives.h
- TMMInstallThread.cpp / TMMInstallThread.h
- TMMFileInfoThread.cpp / TMMFileInfoThread.h

The full application still fails to compile because of the previously known C++Builder 2017-to-2026 Windows SDK/generated-header compatibility errors. Do not remove old archive paths until list, extract, install, progress, cancellation, password, and rollback parity has passed.

## Implementation safeguards

Do not use the convenience ExtractTo() method on unknown third-party archives without verifying traversal and symlink/reparse behavior. Enumerate, reject absolute and parent paths, Windows device paths and ADS, normalise safely, validate extraction destination containment, extract into a staging location, and preserve existing installer logs and rollback. RAR creation is not supported (RAR extraction/read only).

Keep the archive engine in-process at all times. 7z.exe was used only to generate a development 7z fixture, never by the application or Delphi smoke-test binaries.

## Distribution

Maintain MPL 1.1 attribution/source obligations for sevenzip.pas and follow the separate 7-Zip/unRAR licence obligations. Do not publish a third-party DLL in Git without checking redistribution terms.
